name: Soft BiF Volumetric Shadows
definition: A technique for generating high quality volumetric shadows by sampling and interpolation, specifically designed to provide a smooth transition effect in real-time while conserving the crispness of boundaries.
summary: Soft BiF Volumetric Shadows is a real-time technique that reduces computational cost by excluding occluded points via cube shadow maps and smoothing transitions with bilateral filtering while preserving edge crispness.
